question: Martin starts walking from his house in east direction. He walks 10m takes a left and walks 12m. Next he takes a right turn and walks 3m. Then he turns left and walks 1m. He again turns left and walks 5m. Towards which direction is he moving now? (All turns are 90° turns only)
solution:
Given, 

1. Martin starts walking from his house in east direction. 

2. He walks 10m takes a left and walks 12m.

3. Next he takes a right turn and walks 3m. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3f4e297f35bf7ed20457710ae24895f10f93e3748de011dadd0d1e5e5577ca9.png] 

4. .Then he turns left and walks 1m.

5. He again turns left and walks 5m. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74246db4acfd4f63ad20152e10c1d331d4730ce91b3654bc941b9279339b0e94.png] 

 

Therefore, he is moving towards "**West".**

**Hence, the correct answer is "West".**
